At r=0 N isolated vertices; at delta pure-cluster edges kill N-2 H0 classes; the remaining extra H0 class dies at B.
At r=B+(N-2)delta the full N-vertex simplex appears; all positive-degree classes die.
For a cluster smaller than t its skeletal homology contribution vanishes by binomial convention; the split inclusion still holds.
No generalization beyond two equal-within-cluster distances, strong gap, u,v>=2, or symmetrized finite-set ell_1 Rips is claimed.
correctness.rationale: For a pure m-set the minimum path length is (m-1)delta. For mixed sets the number k of interblock transitions is at least 1 and the length is (m-1-k)delta+kB; since B>delta, k=1 by grouping vertices is optimal and w=B+(m-2)delta. The strong gap makes both pure cluster simplices complete before B. For each t=2,...,N-1, the complex is sk_(t-1)Delta_(N-1) union both full cluster simplices. Mayer–Vietoris on their skeletal intersection has split-injective top homology: vertex-collapse simplicial maps to the respective cluster skeletons give a left inverse; the reduced rank is C(N-1,t)-C(u-1,t)-C(v-1,t), with no torsion. For t>=3 the complex is (t-2)-connected because the extra cluster faces have dimension >=t, and a Hurewicz/Whitehead CW argument gives a wedge of (t-1)-spheres. For t=2 contract both cluster simplices to the two vertices of a graph with uv parallel edges, rank uv-1=b_2. The next complete skeleton kills all classes generated by the previous skeleton, so positive-degree bars die at the next mixed threshold and fresh classes enter in the next degree. Pure equilateral skeletons give early bars and H0 has N-2 deaths at delta, one at B and one infinite bar. Boundary t=N-1 gives one S^(N-2) before the full simplex at B+(N-2)delta. These deductions establish the theorem for all N and any coefficient field, independent of finite code.

value.rationale: The two-level equilateral-cluster ultrametric is a natural, interpretable first nontrivial hierarchy. Unlike its classical ell_infinity Rips complex, whose positive-dimensional homology vanishes, its symmetrized ell_1 length-Rips filtration has real high-dimensional bars up through H_(N-2). The result determines every stage homotopy type and every field-independent birth/death and multiplicity for arbitrary u,v>=2, rather than a small census or a restatement of a known table. The exact binomial formula isolates how cluster cardinality controls high-dimensional topology, providing a reusable benchmark for newly introduced ell_p complexes. Its tools are elementary but the complete source-specific filtration computation and map behavior are the motivated contribution; it does not assert arbitrary-ultrametric generality.
residual_risks: The geometry is restricted to a strong-gap two-level model; no claim for unequal intracluster distances or general ultrametric dendrograms.
The method builds from classical simplex-skeleton and Mayer–Vietoris facts; its value rests on the complete new family computation, not a new general topology technique.
